+def get_isbn_10_and_13(isbns: str | list[str]) -> tuple[list[str], list[str]]:
+    """Return usable ISBNs separated by their canonical 10 or 13 character form."""
+    from openlibrary.utils.isbn import normalize_isbn
+
+    values = [isbns] if isinstance(isbns, str) else isbns
+    isbn_10 = []
+    isbn_13 = []
+    if not isinstance(values, (list, tuple)):
+        return isbn_10, isbn_13
+
+    for value in values:
+        if not isinstance(value, str):
+            continue
+        normalized = normalize_isbn(value.strip())
+        if not normalized:
+            continue
+        if (
+            len(normalized) == 10
+            and normalized[:9].isdigit()
+            and normalized[-1] in '0123456789X'
+        ):
+            isbn_10.append(normalized)
+        elif len(normalized) == 13 and normalized.isdigit():
+            isbn_13.append(normalized)
+    return isbn_10, isbn_13
+
+
+def get_publisher_and_place(
+    publishers: str | list[str],
+) -> tuple[list[str], list[str]]:
+    """Separate IA ``Place : Publisher`` values into Open Library fields."""
+    values = [publishers] if isinstance(publishers, str) else publishers
+    publisher_names = []
+    publish_places = []
+    if not isinstance(values, (list, tuple)):
+        return publisher_names, publish_places
+
+    for value in values:
+        if not isinstance(value, str):
+            continue
+        value = value.strip()
+        if not value:
+            continue
+        if ':' in value:
+            place, publisher = (part.strip() for part in value.split(':', 1))
+            if place and publisher:
+                publish_places.append(place)
+                publisher_names.append(publisher)
+                continue
+        publisher_names.append(value)
+    return publisher_names, publish_places
+
+
 class LanguageMultipleMatchError(Exception):
     """Exception raised when more than one possible language match is found."""
